teaching.en: The root vis and its relative vid both carry the idea of seeing.
teaching.zh: 词根 vis/vid 的核心意思是「看见」。

teaching.en: Visible means able to be seen.
teaching.zh: visible 表示「可以被看见」。

teaching.en: Add in- to get invisible, meaning not able to be seen.
teaching.zh: 加上 in- 得到 invisible，表示「看不见」。

teaching.en: Visual describes something connected with seeing.
teaching.zh: visual 与视觉有关。

teaching.en: Advisor is a related extension word, but its connection to seeing is indirect.
teaching.zh: advisor 是拓展词，它和「看」的联系比较间接。

example.en: She has good vision and can read the sign from far away.
example.zh: 她视力很好，从很远的地方就能看清标牌。

example.en: The mountains are clearly visible from the classroom window.
example.zh: 从教室窗户可以清楚地看见群山。

example.en: These tiny organisms are invisible to the naked eye.
example.zh: 这些微小生物用肉眼看不见。

example.en: The chart gives a visual summary of the survey results.
example.zh: 图表用图像概括了调查结果。

example.en: Our class will visit the science museum next week.
example.zh: 我们班下周会去参观科学博物馆。

example.en: We watched a documentary about the ocean on television.
example.zh: 我们在电视上看了一部关于海洋的纪录片。

example.en: She revised her essay after the tutor suggested a clearer introduction.
example.zh: 导师建议把引言写得更清楚后，她修改了自己的作文。

example.en: A teacher will supervise the students during the experiment.
example.zh: 实验期间会有一位老师监督学生。

example.en: Ask your academic advisor for help choosing your courses.
example.zh: 请向学业顾问咨询如何选课。

teaching.en: The root family port has the core meaning “carry.”
teaching.zh: 词根 port 的核心意思是「携带；运送」。

teaching.en: In transport, trans- suggests movement across or between places.
teaching.zh: transport 中的 trans- 有跨越或从一处到另一处的意思。

teaching.en: Import brings goods in, export sends them out, and portable describes what can be carried.
teaching.zh: import 是运进商品，export 是运出商品，portable 形容可以携带的东西。

example.en: The trucks transport fresh food to the city.
example.zh: 卡车把新鲜食物运到城里。

example.en: Some countries import most of their fuel.
example.zh: 有些国家进口所需燃料的大部分。

example.en: Local companies export wine to overseas markets.
example.zh: 本地企业把葡萄酒出口到海外市场。

teaching.en: The root family aud has the core meaning “hear.”
teaching.zh: 词根 aud 的核心意思是「听」。

teaching.en: In audible, -ible gives the sense of able to be: audible sounds can be heard.
teaching.zh: audible 中的 -ible 表示「可以被……」，所以 audible 是「听得见的」。

teaching.en: Add in- for inaudible, a sound you cannot hear.
teaching.zh: 加上 in-，inaudible 就是「听不见的」。

example.en: The speaker answered questions from the audience.
example.zh: 演讲者回答了听众的问题。

example.en: The course provides an audio version of each article.
example.zh: 这门课提供每篇文章的音频版。

example.en: The alarm was audible from the corridor.

teaching.en: The root family act has the core meaning “do or act.”
teaching.zh: 词根 act 的核心意思是「做；行动」。

teaching.en: Act names a deed or the act of doing something.
teaching.zh: act 表示行动。

teaching.en: The ending -ion forms the noun action, and -ive forms the adjective active.
teaching.zh: 加上 -ion 构成名词 action，加上 -ive 构成形容词 active。

example.en: The council must act before the flood season.
example.zh: 议会必须在洪水季之前采取行动。

example.en: The report calls for action on air pollution.
example.zh: 这份报告呼吁采取行动治理空气污染。

example.en: She plays an active role in the research group.
example.zh: 她积极参与研究小组的工作。

teaching.en: The root family loc has the core meaning “place.”
teaching.zh: 词根 loc 的核心意思是「地方；位置」。

teaching.en: Locate means to find or establish a position.
teaching.zh: locate 表示找到位置或设在某处。

teaching.en: Relocate adds the idea of moving to another place.
teaching.zh: relocate 多了「搬到另一个地方」的意思。

example.en: The survey focuses on local businesses.
example.zh: 这项调查关注当地企业。

example.en: The software helps locate faults in the network.
example.zh: 这款软件有助于定位网络故障。

example.en: The site is an ideal location for solar panels.
example.zh: 这个地点很适合安装太阳能板。

example.en: The firm will relocate to a larger site.
example.zh: 公司将搬到更大的场地。

teaching.en: The root family clud has the core meaning “close or shut.”
teaching.zh: 词根 clud 的核心意思是「关；封闭」。

teaching.en: Think of a boundary: include puts something inside it, and exclude keeps it outside.
teaching.zh: 想象一道边界：include 把某样东西纳入其中，exclude 把它留在外面。

teaching.en: In conclude, the image is bringing an activity or argument to a close.
teaching.zh: conclude 则有结束活动或论述的意思。

example.en: The total does not include delivery.
example.zh: 总价不包括送货费。

example.en: The researchers exclude incomplete responses.
example.zh: 研究人员排除了不完整的答卷。

example.en: The researchers conclude that the change had little effect.
example.zh: 研究人员得出结论，认为这一变动影响很小。

teaching.en: The root family grad or gress has the core meaning “step or move.”
teaching.zh: 词根 grad/gress 的核心意思是「迈步；移动」。

teaching.en: Gradual change happens in steps.
teaching.zh: gradual 描述逐步发生的变化。

teaching.en: Progress means moving forward, while regress means going back to an earlier state.
teaching.zh: progress 表示向前取得进展，regress 表示退回早先的状态。

teaching.en: Grade can mean a level or a result in an assessment.
teaching.zh: grade 可以指级别或评估成绩。

example.en: The town saw a gradual decline in traffic.
example.zh: 该镇的交通流量逐步下降。

example.en: The surface gradually cooled after sunset.
example.zh: 日落后，表面逐渐冷却。

example.en: She received a high grade for her essay.
example.zh: 她的作文取得了好成绩。

example.en: Most students graduate after three years.

example.en: The team made steady progress on the project.

teaching.en: The root family numer has the core meaning “number.”
teaching.zh: 词根 numer 的核心意思是「数；数量」。

teaching.en: Numerical means expressed in numbers.
teaching.zh: numerical 表示以数字呈现。

teaching.en: Numerous describes a large number of things.
teaching.zh: numerous 表示数量很多。

teaching.en: Enumerate means to list items one by one.
teaching.zh: enumerate 表示逐项列举。

example.en: The survey includes numerical and written responses.

teaching.en: The root family junct has the core meaning “join or connect.”
teaching.zh: 词根 junct 的核心意思是「连接」。

teaching.en: A junction is where things meet or join.
teaching.zh: junction 是事物相交或连接的地方。

teaching.en: A conjunction in grammar connects words, phrases, or clauses.

example.en: Turn right at the junction near the hospital.

teaching.en: The root family lev has the core meaning “lift or raise.”
teaching.zh: 词根 lev 的核心意思是「举起；提升」。

teaching.en: Elevate means to raise something, literally or figuratively.
teaching.zh: elevate 表示抬高，可以是实际高度，也可以是抽象程度。

teaching.en: Elevation can describe how high a place is above sea level.
teaching.zh: elevation 可以指某地的海拔。

example.en: A platform elevates the equipment above the water.

example.en: The new road may relieve traffic congestion.

teaching.en: The root family migr has the core meaning “move from one place to another.”
teaching.zh: 词根 migr 的核心意思是「迁移；从一地移动到另一地」。

teaching.en: Migrate is the general word for moving between places.
teaching.zh: migrate 是从一个地方迁到另一个地方的通用词。

teaching.en: Immigrate points to entering a country to live, and emigrate focuses on leaving one's home country.
teaching.zh: immigrate 强调迁入一个国家定居，emigrate 强调从自己的国家迁出。

example.en: Many birds migrate when winter arrives.
example.zh: 许多鸟在冬季来临时迁徙。

example.en: The study tracks the migration of butterflies.

example.en: Her parents decided to immigrate to Australia.

example.en: Many families chose to emigrate from the region's poorest country.
